title: Seul Choix Point Lighthouse: The Keeper Who Never Left

sources.what: 'supposedly named by French sailors' whose 'only choice' for shelter was the bay; 'preferred pronunciation is Sis-shwa'; lens 'placed in operation on August 15, 1895'; Joseph W. Townshend 'passed away in the dwelling in 1910' and 'lay in state in the downstairs parlor until his relatives could gather'; cigar smell, moved silverware, face in a mirror; owned by Michigan DNR, managed by the Gulliver Historical Society

'Capt. Joseph Willie Townshend' 'died in 1910 inside the lighthouse'; Marilyn Fischer, society president: 'I've written over 150 true stories that have happened to our house guests and volunteers'; open Memorial Day weekend to end of September
Fischer, 'president of Gulliver Historical Society': 'I've written over 150 true stories that have happened to our house guests and volunteers'
'An operational Light'; run by the Gulliver Historical Society; cigar smoke; face in mirror

beats.text: Visitors say they smell cigar smoke in this lighthouse. Nobody is smoking.
beats.label: MICHIGAN'S UPPER PENINSULA

beats.text: This is Seul Choix Point, on Lake Michigan near Gulliver, Michigan. The name is French for only choice.
beats.label: "ONLY CHOICE"

beats.text: The tower's light was first lit in 1895, and it still guides ships today.
beats.label: TOWER LIT 1895

beats.text: In 1910, keeper Joseph Willie Townshend died in the keeper's house. Accounts say he lay in state in the parlor until his family could gather.
beats.label: THE KEEPER, 1910

beats.text: Since then, volunteers and guests have reported the smell of his cigars, silverware moved on the table, and a man's face in a mirror.
beats.label: WHAT PEOPLE REPORT

beats.text: The president of the Gulliver Historical Society says she has written more than 150 true stories from guests and volunteers.
beats.label: 150 STORIES
beats.credit: Marilyn Fischer, via Michigan Blue magazine

beats.text: Comment your town, and it could be next.

end_card.pill: Museum open Memorial Day weekend through September
